mistakes.description: CAT CLI launcher was invoked repeatedly without required CAT environment variables because the invoking skill did not show the full runtime environment preamble.
mistakes.root_cause: CAT skill instructions for direct client/bin launcher calls under-specified required runtime-neutral environment setup, so the agent used trial-and-error retries (adding CAT_SESSION_ID, then CAT_PROJECT_DIR, then CAT_PLUGIN_DATA) instead of loading the complete Codex CAT environment block first.
mistakes.correct_behavior: Before invoking any CAT launcher under client/bin, initialize CAT_PLUGIN_ROOT, CAT_PLUGIN_DATA, CAT_CONFIG_DIR, CAT_PROJECT_DIR, CAT_RUNTIME, and CAT_SESSION_ID in the same command invocation or abort.

mistakes.description: git-squash/git-rebase launchers returned conflict JSON but no active interactive rebase state was available for continuation, leading to manual fallback attempts outside deterministic workflow.
mistakes.root_cause: DOCUMENTATION GAP: git-rebase and downstream merge/squash guidance described CONFLICT handling as if a resumable interactive rebase state persisted, but the git-rebase launcher aborts the rebase before returning CONFLICT JSON. This mismatch primed agents to attempt git rebase --continue without an active rebase state.
mistakes.correct_behavior: When git-rebase returns CONFLICT, treat it as a post-abort conflict report. Start a native rebase session explicitly before any git rebase --continue steps, resolve conflicts there, then rerun deterministic squash/rebase workflow instead of bypassing with ad-hoc squash fallbacks.
